purpose: Rules for exchanging transient per-process data (requests and results) between a SKILL and a custom Agent via identifiers, script-written JSON, and exit values, so handoff does not break regardless of data size.
summary: Scope: transient data versus permanent documents
Why prompt and return value are not used to carry data
Carry only identifiers generated by scripts
Scripts write data; AI never assembles JSON
Readers obtain an absolute path from a script and read directly
Values arrive unaltered, including quotes and non-ASCII
Field meaning lives in SKILL.md or agent definitions
Finalize before writing; no overwrite; exit value "0" means success
No runtime format validation; absolute paths allowed; delete after processing
Items each feature decides: identifiers, location, fields, error values
tasks: Designing SKILL to custom Agent data handoff
Writing agent definitions that deliver results via script
Defining exit values and error value sets
title: agent とのデータ受け渡し
